purpose: Paper-matched benchmark against ChatLeafDisease (Pan et al., Plant Phenomics 7(3):100094, 2025) PlantSeg experiment (reported 77.3 % accuracy)
known_overlap_with_history: Track S/T queries are PlantSeg images that were partly included in the earlier 1,485-query external evaluation (already inspected); that result stays historical evidence and is NOT used to tune anything here.
fixed_models: D5ck_dinoB_p4_supcon_lr3e-5_s{0,1,2} (DINOv2-B last-4 blocks + SupCon, trained on SegPPD train_B only; checkpoints in artifacts/checkpoints). Frozen DINOv2-B CLS as feature control. No retraining, no hyper-parameter search, no checkpoint selection.
exclusions: PlantSeg images flagged as SegPPD copies/crops (hash rule or DINOv2-B cos>=0.85); images in near-duplicate groups that span more than one category (label conflicts) are dropped; within a duplicate group only the lexicographically first image is kept as a query.

trackS.name: source-only transfer (no PlantSeg label is used anywhere)
trackS.queries: deduplicated, screened PlantSeg images of the 5 categories that have an equivalent SegPPD class: tomato bacterial leaf spot (->92), tomato late blight (->94), grape black rot (->42), strawberry leaf scorch (->81), bell pepper bacterial spot (->71, loose tier)
trackS.gallery: all usable SegPPD images (2,220 after duplicate removal) restricted to the classes of the query's crop (crop-conditional, as in the paper where descriptions are given per crop): tomato 91-95, grape 41-44, strawberry 79-81, pepper 70-73. Secondary variant: crop-agnostic gallery = all 101 SegPPD classes.
trackS.label_universe_note: SegPPD has no equivalent for tomato early blight / mosaic virus / yellow leaf curl virus and grape leaf blight (4 of 9 paper categories, 265 of 507 paper images): they cannot be predicted by a source-only retrieval and are therefore NOT part of the evaluated query set; this is a reduced category coverage, not a like-for-like label universe.
methods: 1-NN retrieval with exact L2 on SupCon embeddings (3 seeds)
logistic regression (C=1, standardised features, label-restricted to the crop) on SupCon embeddings
logistic regression on frozen DINOv2-B CLS
trackS.same_supervision: all methods use exactly the same labelled SegPPD reference images (gallery = LR training set)

trackT.name: target-domain k-shot (uses PlantSeg labels; separate track, not comparable to zero-shot ChatLD)
trackT.categories: all 9 paper categories incl. grape 'Leaf Blight' assumed = PlantSeg 'grape leaf spot' (unverified assumption)
trackT.label_universe: per crop: tomato {bacterial spot, early blight, late blight, mosaic virus, yellow leaf curl virus, healthy}; grape {black rot, leaf blight(assumed), healthy}; strawberry {leaf scorch, healthy}; pepper {bacterial spot, healthy}. 'healthy' references come from SegPPD (no healthy image exists in PlantSeg).
trackT.references: k in {1,5,10} PlantSeg images per disease category drawn at random (20 draws, seeds 0-19), plus all usable SegPPD healthy images of the crop
trackT.queries: remaining deduplicated, screened PlantSeg images, group-disjoint from the references, sampled per category up to the paper's Table S2 count (stratified, same seed)

metrics: macro-F1 of top-1 over categories with support
P@5, P@10, mAP (relevance = same class label inside the crop gallery)
exact McNemar test between methods on identical queries
not_reproducible: ChatLD itself is not reproduced: needs paid GPT-4o API (no key / not permitted), the condensed disease-description database and code are unpublished, test image IDs unreleased.
